name: Warsong Oil
summary: At the Warsong Lumber Camp, Warsong Oil keeps the logging machinery running. A satyr ambush has carried a shipment into corrupted forest enclaves.

sections.title: Stolen Machinery Fuel
sections.body: Warsong Oil keeps the Warsong Clan's logging machinery running in Ashenvale. Goblin-engineered shredders and massive sawmills need a steady supply of the lubricant. Without it, timber cutting could halt, slowing the lumber needed to build Orgrimmar and fortify Horde settlements across Durotar and the Barrens.

sections.title: Rituals of the Satyr
sections.body: Satyrs ambushed a shipment of Warsong Oil before it could reach Splintertree Post and the logging camps. They carried the containers into corrupted enclaves, including Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian, where they use the flammable lubricant in their rituals.

faq.q: What is Warsong Oil used for?
faq.answer: Warsong Oil keeps the Warsong Lumber Camp's heavy shredders, saws, and timber-cutting machinery running.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs have the oil?
faq.answer: Satyrs ambushed a supply convoy bound for Splintertree Post on the roads of Ashenvale. They took the oil for their rituals in ruined settlements.

faq.q: Where can Warsong Oil be found?
faq.answer: Satyr-controlled sites in Ashenvale hold containers of Warsong Oil, especially Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian.
Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post needs Warsong Oil, saw blades, rope, and axes to resupply the struggling Warsong lumber operation.

angles.text: For the Horde, Ashenvale timber supports its footholds in Durotar and the Barrens. When demon-worshiping satyrs take the machinery oil, construction in those young settlements suffers.
Engineers know goblin-designed shredder joints and buzzsaws need steady lubrication. Without it, they burn out within hours of timber logging.
